_about: Containment posture for the Riverbend synthetic engagement. This is the half of the defence that still holds after the model has been successfully persuaded.

egress._note: Exactly one host. The drafting model is reachable; nothing else is. An injected instruction to POST anywhere else fails at the network, not at the prompt. Adding a host here is an operator decision with a written reason.

credentials._note: Task-scoped and short-lived, so a leaked credential is already dead. Never supplied via environment variables: this process executes model-directed logic, and the environment is readable by anything it runs.

execution._note: Everything else is read-only to the running process. The adapter additionally has no write method, so a filesystem permission error is the second line, not the first.
